title: Fourier Series
description: Demonstrates Fourier series approximation of a square wave. A gray square wave target is plotted, then odd harmonics (n = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9) are progressively added. Each step shows a yellow curve that transforms closer to the square wave as more terms are summed using the formula (4/πn)·sin(nx). Info labels announce each added harmonic.

n_terms.description: Number of Fourier harmonics to add (uses odd n up to 2·n_terms − 1)

key_objects: Fourier approximation curve (yellow, transforms each step)
what_to_modify: Change the target waveform (sawtooth, triangle), increase n_terms for better approximation, add individual harmonic curves in different colors, show the Gibbs phenomenon, or animate the convergence continuously.
